By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darksider]] '''guardian entity''' was responsible for protecting the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]]'s sanctuary, named the [[Fount of Rajivari]], on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. He would only allow purified individuals to enter the Fount and during the time of the conflict, a powerful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] attempted to enter the sanctuary however, the Jedi refused to be purified and was instead attacked by the Guardian, both physically and mentally. Despite this, the Padawan would reach the Fount of Rajivari alive and with his mind intact.

==Powers and abilities==
He was capable of [[pyrokinesis]] as demonstrated when he ignited the future [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]. He was also capable of causing [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusions]].
